description: Figure 9 (the bottom plot) is a grouped vertical bar chart illustrating model evaluation scores across a set of academic and practical benchmarks, comparing two models. The horizontal axis contains the benchmark categories labeled (left to right) GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (+5), and Chat-Arena-Hard, with the axis label “Dataset and Metrics.” The vertical axis is labeled “Score (%)” and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80 with regularly spaced tick marks at 10-point intervals. Each category has two adjacent bars: a blue bar for “LLaMA-3-8B-it” and an orange bar for “Ours (Iterative RLHF),” as indicated by the legend titled “Model” in the upper right. Approximate bar heights are: GSM-8K ~79 (blue) and ~80 (orange); MMLU ~66 (blue) and ~65 (orange); HumanEval ~61 (blue) and ~64 (orange); TruthfulQA ~44 (blue) and ~60 (orange); ARC ~59 (blue) and ~63 (orange); MBPP ~61 (blue) and ~60 (orange); LC AlpacaEval-2 ~23 (blue) and ~31 (orange); MT-Bench (+5) ~41 (blue) and ~42 (orange); Chat-Arena-Hard ~20 (blue) and ~29 (orange). The bars are not visually emphasized with annotations or special outlines, and the categories appear in a fixed benchmark order rather than being sorted by bar height.
